title: Optimal insulation and concentration breaking for nonlinear Robin boundary value problems
summary: We consider an optimal insulation problem for a bounded domain in $\mathbb{R}^N$ driven by the $p$-Laplace operator ($p>1$). We model the convective heat transfer between the body and the environment, which corresponds, before insulation, to a nonlinear Robin boundary value problem. Assuming the body is surrounded by a thin layer of insulating material of size $\varepsilon^{\frac{1}{p-1}}$, we compute the $Γ$-limit of the governing energy functional as $\varepsilon \to 0^+$. Furthermore, we study the optimization of the heat content among all possible distributions of the insulating material…
